panels.title: GitHub calls by operation and actor
panels.description: Calls made through CSF's GitHub tools (MCP, HTTP routes and csf github), per second over the selected window, by operation and actor: operator or virtual_session. Counted from the host's GitHub log (<state>/github.jsonl) at each scrape, so the series survive a restart. Missing or stale targets show no data, not zero.

panels.title: GitHub calls that failed
panels.description: Failed calls per second by operation and actor: GitHub's refusals (HTTP status and its message are in the GitHub log) and inputs the tools refused before calling GitHub.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, actor) (rate(csf_github_calls_total{instance="$instance", outcome="failed"}[$__rate_interval])) and on() (max(up{instance="$instance"}) == 1)

panels.title: Rate-limit headroom
panels.description: Share of GitHub's core rate limit left in the current window, as the latest call that reported it saw: csf_github_rate_remaining over csf_github_rate_limit. It moves only when a call is made; between calls it holds the last reading.

panels.title: Requests left this window
panels.description: csf_github_rate_remaining of csf_github_rate_limit, as the latest call that reported it saw.
